account_id.description: The ID of the account this request belongs to.

created_at.description: Full datetime the request was created.

creator_id.description: The ID of the user creating the request.

end_time.description: Full datetime the request ends at.

hours.description: The number of hours of paid time off to use.

status.description:
The current status of the request. The field user_status is more
granular (it supports the Denied status) and should be used instead of
status..
  * `0` = Pending
  * `1` = Canceled
  * `2` = Accepted
  * `3` = Expired

start_time.description: Full datetime the request starts at.

type.description:
DEPRECATED IN FAVOR OF `type_id`. SEE Request Type.

The type of timeoff request being made
 * `0` - Unpaid Time Off
 * `1` - Paid Time Off
 * `2` - Sick
 * `3` - Holiday

type_id.description:
The RequestType ID referencing the type of timeoff (Personal, Sick, Holiday).

Only certain plans can create non-built-in types.

type_label.description: The label for the custom timeoff type (Personal, Sick, Holiday)

paid.description: If the timeoff request is for paid timeoff

updated_at.description: Full datetime the request was last updated.

user_id.description: The ID of the user requesting time off.

can_edit.description:
Is the timeoff request editable by the authenticated user.
* `true`
* `false`

user_status.description:
The current user status of the request.
* `0` = Pending
* `1` = Canceled
* `2` = Accepted
* `3` = Expired
* `4` = Denied
